files_changed.delta: Added bounded reader _consult_skill_lint (consults existing _attach_lint_findings -> tools.skill_linter); wired it into _edit_skill (full-rewrite/edit/apply path) with a pre-write before-capture. No cap/threshold/policy constant touched.
Extended _ADVISORY_KEYS to also forward lint_evaluation_status and full_current_lint_findings, so batch results carry the same findings shape as single mode.

reader_shape.behavior: Locates the target skill (or uses the caller-supplied skill_md), and if SKILL.md exists calls the existing primitive with the pre-write content (before) so the delta (lint_warnings) is preserved while the full current list is recorded. A skill that cannot be located or whose SKILL.md is absent records nothing (no fabricated clean list; UNAVAILABLE/absent stays distinct from an evaluated empty list).

now_wired: single mode: _edit_skill (full rewrite / edit / apply) consults the reader
single mode: _create_skill and _patch_skill already consulted the primitive (phase 1)
single mode: _write_file (references/) already consulted the primitive (phase 1)
batch mode: _skill_manage_batch._ADVISORY_KEYS forwards lint_evaluation_status + full_current_lint_findings per op
still_unwired: _remove_file does not consult the lint primitive (no SKILL.md content change; left as-is)

the staged-write / approval replay path (_run_write_gate -> apply_skill_pending) only reaches the reader indirectly through the replay of the underlying edit/patch/create handler; its staged JSON payload itself is not lint-annotated
no downstream enforcement/repair consumer: findings are recorded and reported, not acted upon
no independent checker verdict; this is a maker self-report only
no broad suite run (only the two named test files were executed)
